doc: Share of the variance lost by a 2x2 box average brought back bilinearly (rows clamp, columns wrap): the image is converted to float64 first, then every step is float64 (floor, clip, bilinear lerp, population variance), so a port is within 1e-9 (numpy against exactly rounded math.fsum sums: < 5e-16 relative). A flat map (0.25, exactly representable so the variance is exactly 0 in any summation order) has no variance: the 0 branch, not 0 / 0.
